'''Halaib Aweti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halaib Aweti appears as the armstech trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', released on [[December 2]], [[2014]] as an expansion the the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
